title: Yankee Freedom Dry Tortugas Ferry
specs: Visit one of America's most remote national parks with historic Fort Jefferson
Snorkeling over coral reefs with abundant marine life
Year-round service with comfortable ferry and scenic views
All adults must show photo ID at check-in; seniors, students, and active military must show proper ID for discounts
Campers must comply with camping rules and gear inspection before boarding
No compressed gas canisters, flammable accelerants, or firearms allowed onboard
Reservations held until 7:45 am on day of trip; standby tickets available first-come basis at terminal
includes: Entrance fee to Dry Tortugas National Park and Fort Jefferson
Breakfast snack and box lunch on day trips
Snorkel gear and fins provided for reefs
gap: Exact prices for overnight camping tickets not stated separately from day trip fare
blurb: Yankee Freedom III offers daily high-speed ferry trips to Dry Tortugas National Park, including Fort Jefferson. The ferry departs from Key West and provides a round trip the same day or overnight camping options. Passengers can enjoy snorkeling gear, snacks, and a box lunch on day trips.
